summary: Red Bull faces a critical test of its dominance at Zandvoort without injured driver Isack Hadjar, forcing the team to shuffle its lineup and potentially disrupting the momentum it built before the summer break. The midfield battle intensifies as rivals like Cadillac and Haas emerge from their off-season questions with fresh strategies, threatening to capitalize on any Red Bull instability this weekend. With Zandvoort hosting Formula 1 for the final time, every championship point becomes magnified—this farewell race could reshape the title fight heading into the final stretch of the season.
